description: This file defines two interfaces for Orleans grains used in testing reentrant and local stress scenarios. It includes method signatures for echoing data, retrieving runtime IDs, pinging with optional delays, and testing interleaving consistency with various data structures.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Echoes back the provided byte array.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping with the provided data.

methods.name: PingWithDelay
methods.description: Sends a ping with the provided data and a specified delay.

methods.name: PingMutableArray
methods.description: Pings with a mutable array, specifying the next grain and whether it is remote.

methods.name: PingImmutableArray
methods.description: Pings with an immutable array, specifying the next grain and whether it is remote.

methods.name: PingMutableDictionary
methods.description: Pings with a mutable dictionary, specifying the next grain and whether it is remote.

methods.name: PingImmutableDictionary
methods.description: Pings with an immutable dictionary, specifying the next grain and whether it is remote.

methods.name: InterleavingConsistencyTest
methods.description: Performs an interleaving consistency test with the specified number of items.

calls: Task PingMutableArray(byte[] data, long nextGrain, bool nextGrainIsRemote)
Task PingImmutableArray(Immutable<byte[]> data, long nextGrain, bool nextGrainIsRemote)
Task PingMutableDictionary(Dictionary<int, string> data, long nextGrain, bool nextGrainIsRemote)
Task PingImmutableDictionary(Immutable<Dictionary<int, string>> data, long nextGrain, bool nextGrainIsRemote)
